name: 種子槍手
prompt: Production animation sheet for EXACT character in reference. EIGHT equally spaced columns and 5 rows, 40 full-body drawings. Wide landscape sheet, maximum resolution. Column directions FIXED in every row: 1 FRONT; 2 FRONT RIGHT; 3 RIGHT PROFILE; 4 BACK RIGHT; 5 BACK; 6 BACK LEFT; 7 LEFT PROFILE; 8 FRONT LEFT. Columns6,7,8 noses point SCREEN LEFT. Back shows back, no face. Same creature identity, anatomy, colors and equipment in ALL views, never mirror handedness. Rows 1 and 2 are WINDUP start and full charge; rows 3,4,5 are attack release, followthrough, recovery. Aim tubular pod head, swell seed chamber, then recoil in rapid seed burst. Peapod plant gunner, upright botanical body, long tubular hollow seedpod head aimed forward, overlapping green pod armor and vine limbs, deep forest green/purple seed chambers, no firearm. Detailed Japanese manga dark fantasy JRPG monster illustration, fine variable-weight ink lines, cel-shaded shadows plus subtle gradients and highlights, consistent upper-left light. Slightly stylized semi-chibi proportions: humanoids about 4.5 to 5 heads tall, mature faces, slightly larger head and hands, compact limbs; creatures have heads about 12% larger than natural with compact expressive silhouette. NOT tiny 2.5-head chibi, not baby-like, no cute face, no smile. Corrupted ancient forest palette: dark/moss green, bark brown, poison purple; yellow-green or teal emissive details. Entire character and appendages visible. Real transparent background alpha=0, absolutely no paper/backdrop/ground shadow or broad ambient glow. Identical camera scale across every frame including collapsed ones. All feet/tails/weapons fit INSIDE each cell with at least 12% empty gutters on ALL sides. No grid or labels. NO overlapping neighbors; no clipping. Return a clean RGBA sprite sheet.
